name: Stay card
summary: A holiday rental or hotel listing: a swipeable photo carousel with dots, a favourite heart, the place, host and dates, the rating, and the price per night with the total.
use: in a list or map of places to stay, for one listing a traveller can save or open
a11y: The title is the one link; previous and next photo buttons appear on hover or focus and announce the photo count, the heart is a toggle button with aria-pressed, and each photo has alt text.

use_when: a grid of search results where each place needs several photos and a save action before the person opens it
avoid_when: a restaurant with cuisine and opening times: use restaurant-card
a full booked trip with times and codes: use itinerary
a list of saved places to compare: use wishlist-grid

parts.name: photos
parts.what: one photo in the swipeable carousel

parts.name: badge
parts.what: a short label over the first photo

parts.name: favourite
parts.what: a heart toggle to save the place

parts.name: prev
parts.what: previous photo, shown on hover or focus

parts.name: next
parts.what: next photo, shown on hover or focus

parts.name: dots
parts.what: one dot per photo, the current one brighter

parts.name: title
parts.what: the place's name, the card's one link

parts.name: lines
parts.what: one line of details: host and features, then dates

parts.name: price
parts.what: old price struck through, price a night and the total

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if saving fails, set the heart back and show the reason in toast-stack

disabled.how: on the first photo the previous button is disabled and hidden, and on the last photo the next button

overflow.how: photos sit in a sideways scroll strip that snaps one photo at a time, and the dots and photo count follow

long_text.how: a long title wraps in balanced lines beside the rating, which never shrinks; price parts wrap onto a new line

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches the heart, then the next or previous photo button, then the title link
Enter or Space on the heart saves or unsaves the place
Enter or Space on the photo buttons moves one photo, and the photo count is updated
Enter on the title opens the place
